hero.title: Software you can read
hero.subtitle: Open source without fine print
hero.description: We are NurApps. We make plain apps with public sources: you can download, inspect and build them yourself. Four projects, three licenses, zero trackers.
hero.note: Honest labels: beta means beta, and when there is nothing to download we say so.

about.title: A workshop, not a corporation
about.content: NurApps is a few developers tired of apps that read you faster than you read them. We ship slowly, publish sources first, and don't promise what isn't there.
values: No surveillance — no analytics to sell
Old machines welcome — light builds for Windows and Linux
We answer in Issues — slowly, but like humans

questions.q: Is it really free? What's the catch?
questions.a: Yes, free. No catch: the code is open, the license lets you use and modify it. We plan to earn on support and donations, not on data.

questions.q: What do beta and draft mean?
questions.a: Beta works but may break and updates often. Draft has nothing to download yet. We label statuses honestly so you don't expect stability where there is none.

questions.q: Where do I download if there is no button?
questions.a: All builds live in Releases on GitHub. The download button leads straight there. NurStore is a Telegram bot — its button opens the chat.

questions.q: How do I report a bug or suggest a fix?
questions.a: Open Issues in the right repository: what you did, what you expected, what happened. A screenshot and OS version speed things up.
Yes: translations, error texts, testing on old hardware, triaging Issues. Write into any repo and we'll point you where to start.
